notice.title: Certificate Verification Schedule for the post of Village Health Nurse Phase III

clauses.text: The candidates are called for verification of certificates / documents based on the marks secured by the candidates in the Computer Based Test and particulars furnished in their on-line applications such as age, educational qualification, community, etc and other relevant rules in vogue

The provisional selection of candidates will be made only after verification/ acceptance of certain documents, educational qualification possessed by him/her, clarification regarding community status and its acceptance, marks / rank list of the candidate, genuineness of the Incentive marks for…
Evidence and Mark sheet of Educational qualification (SSLC,HSC and Certificate Course in Auxiliary Nurse Midwife / Village Health Nurse) c
